subject: Malaysia M-510: Limelook assessment and a 1 kg sample
body:
For Limelook's lime-paint application, M-510 requires formulation assessment. Its TDS describes chloride-process rutile with zirconium/aluminium treatment and lists wall latex paints.

Our REACH registration certificate is available for review.

I've attached the M-510 TDS and REACH information for your review.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample.

Could your relevant technical team confirm whether to arrange a sample evaluation?
